content:
Multiplying by \(xy\):

\[
x^2y+2016y=32xy^2+63x.
\]

Rearranging:

\[
x(xy-63)=y(32xy-2016).
\]

Since \(\gcd(x,y)=1\), we get \(x\mid 2016\). Similarly,

\[
y(x^2+2016-32xy)=63x,
\]

so \(y\mid 63\). Thus \(y\in\{1,3,7,9,21,63\}\).

For each \(y\), compute \(C=32y+\frac{63}{y}\), then solve \(x+\frac{2016}{x}=C\):

\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
y & C & \text{roots }x & \text{coprime with }y\\
\hline
1 & 95 & 32,63 & 32,63\\
3 & 117 & 21,96 & \text{none}\\
7 & 233 & 9,224 & 9\\
9 & 295 & 7,288 & 7\\
21 & 675 & 3,672 & \text{none}\\
63 & 2017 & 1,2016 & 1
\end{array}
\]

Total valid pairs:

\[
2+0+1+1+0+1=5.
\]

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
